title: Database Management
text:
Breadcrumbs
This section helps you repair sub-flow issues that can affect revision history and connectors.
The
Fix sub-flow’s revision
and
Fix sub-flow’s connectors
buttons are available in Leapwork Flow, under Settings and then
Database Management
.
Use
Fix sub-flow's revision
history if you upgraded from an older Leapwork version and sub-flows fail because of revision history changes in the database.
Use
Fix sub-flow's connectors
if you upgraded from an older Leapwork version and sub-flows show multiple input or output connectors because of revision history changes in the database.
Note:
Database Management settings would be available if you are logged in as an administrator.
Note
: The screenshots on this page use the
Elegance Design
, introduced in
2025.3
. If you are using an earlier version, your layout may look different.
Fix sub-flow's revision history button
: If you upgraded from an older Leapwork version and face flow failures in sub-flows due to revision history changes in the database, this is helpful.
Fix sub-flow's connectors button
: If you upgraded from an older Leapwork version and face issues with sub-flows showing multiple input/output connectors due to revision history changes in the database, this is helpful.
